newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela non-oil exports to rise to $6 bln in 97.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela non-oil exports to rise to $6 bln in 97.

text.p: The Venezuelan government sees non-traditional exports, which exclude oil and iron, rising about $1 billion to $6 billion next year, vice Planning Minister Armando Leon said Friday.
Non-traditional exports in 1995 totaled $4.580 billion and are seen edging up to $5 billion this year, Leon said.
The boost in exports will be driven by increasing trade agreements, including a move to join the Mercosur trading group of Brazil, Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay.

Venezuelan officials have said they hope to join Mercosur by the end of the year and Leon said Friday's meeting of economic ministers had agreed to pursue a fast coupling with the common market of 160 million people.
